Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging

Interface ReleaseChangeProcess

  • All Known Subinterfaces:
    AbstractReplicationService.ReplicationProcess
    All Known Implementing Classes:
    AbstractReplicationService.AbstractReplicationProcess, InPlacePublisherService.InPlaceReleasePublishingProcess
    public interface ReleaseChangeProcess
    A process or workflow that can be triggered by a ReleaseChangeEvent which, for instance, replicates the release into a remote system. This is meant for operations that can take some time, as opposed to quick operations that can be done immediately within ReleaseChangeEventListener.receive(ReleaseChangeEvent). The processes can be shown in the GUI and checked for their state.

      • isImplicit

        boolean isImplicit()
        If true, this is a "second class" configuration: it is implicitly present if there is no explicit configuration done. It will only be used if there is no explicit configuration of any type - an explicit configuration overrides it.

      • needsReschedule

        default boolean needsReschedule()
        If this returns true, our scheduler should #run() the process again soon.

      • abort

        default void abort()
        If the process is currently running, this triggers an abort. Caution: this might take a while since the currently running operation might have to be finished / resources might need to be cleared up. If the process is stopped, it resets the state to ReleaseChangeProcess.ReleaseChangeProcessorState.idle to allow "acknowledging" an error.

      • triggerProcessing

        void triggerProcessing​(@NotNull
                       @NotNull ReleaseChangeEvent event)
        Adds the information about the event into an internal queue. Shouldn't throw any exceptions and not do anything risky - the actual processing is done when #run() is called. If there is anything to do and run should be triggered, the getState() should be switched to ReleaseChangeProcess.ReleaseChangeProcessorState.awaiting. The caller guarantees that #run() is called soon.

      • runReplication

        void runReplication()
        This method performs the actual replication processing. This is meant to be automatically called from the internal release change publishing mechanism (specifically ReleaseChangeEventPublisherImpl, not a part of the GUI.

        The contract with the ReleaseChangeEventPublisherImpl is: it calls this method after changes to the release have been received, e.g. by entering the ReleaseChangeProcess into a threadpool. Must not be called twice in parallel. If there is nothing in the queue, this should just be a no-op.

      • compareTree

        @Nullable
ReleaseChangeEventPublisher.CompareResult compareTree​(@NotNull
                                                      @NotNull com.composum.sling.core.ResourceHandle resource,
                                                      int details)
                                               throws ReplicationException
        Compares the the tree below resource with the remote system's content and determines whether there are differences.
        Parameters:
        resource - the release root or a subtree in there
        details - If 0, only difference counts are returned. If 1, the different paths are included. For some replication types higher values switch on further checks.
        Returns:
        the differences, or null if not enabled
        Throws:
        ReplicationException
